body:
The ONE authorized RCC successor has now completed the owned real maintained-repository workload through normal Acquire and public ExecuteWithStreams. Immutable checkpoint `6a1ddce272211fbdc84a9100bf45f55c32710810` was independently remote-byte verified: 399 files/15,723,220 bytes, all 3,353 parent entries preserved. [Report](https://github.com/joshyorko/rcc/blob/6a1ddce272211fbdc84a9100bf45f55c32710810/developer/swarm/20261011/representative-2110/report.md), [exact ledger](https://github.com/joshyorko/rcc/blob/6a1ddce272211fbdc84a9100bf45f55c32710810/developer/swarm/20261011/representative-2110/execution-ledger.json), [raw results](https://github.com/joshyorko/rcc/blob/6a1ddce272211fbdc84a9100bf45f55c32710810/developer/swarm/20261011/representative-2110/results-group-2/controller.jsonl), [independent review](https://github.com/joshyorko/rcc/blob/6a1ddce272211fbdc84a9100bf45f55c32710810/developer/swarm/20261011/representative-2110/postmeasurement-independent-review.md).

Six accepted arms ran 540 unmodified maintained test cases plus 18 full-tree guidance validations. Corrected v4-only two-pair complete-controller medians were 7.085s fresh versus 5.663s finite-resident (20.074% descriptive difference); individual pairs 7.321/5.750s and 6.849/5.575s. The accepted first pair remains retained v3, never replayed. The original pair2 resident worker PASS had a failed/missing outer sampler result and remains rejected, excluded from all performance statistics. Full pooled outer samples are mixed observers, not one unchanged cohort. No old accepted wave or invalid60.253/6.283ms warm comparison was replayed.

Owned private Linux cancellation found a real frozen direct-child supervisor barrier: a sleeping grandchild survived. That FAILED control and exact fallback remain preserved. A separately reviewed private Setpgid/subreaper/pidfd/Wait4 overlay reaped both recorded identities before lease release and before any outer fallback. Poison/error→clean-probe and fresh/resident untimed smoke passed. All17 materializations produced 8,721 size/hash checks with zero mismatches; 681 frozen inputs/535 build bindings/519 retained provider files unchanged; no leases/task tempdirs/live worker executables. Artifact bin/python delegates hostPython3.12.14; cooperative task state reset is not hostile-code or OS isolation, a daemon, full contained toolkit, or Actions qualification.

v18.19.6 remains PUBLICATION HOLD under185; shipping7945/5a6a is unchanged and distinct from Actions candidate727/be55. No production format/default/source change, tag, release or publisher dispatch. Draft224/225 stay NO-GO. Research does not close125 or clear a release gate.

Lifecycle receipts: [failed frozen direct-child control](https://github.com/joshyorko/rcc/blob/6a1ddce272211fbdc84a9100bf45f55c32710810/developer/swarm/20261011/representative-2110/results-negative-2/independent-review.md), [private overlay](https://github.com/joshyorko/rcc/blob/6a1ddce272211fbdc84a9100bf45f55c32710810/developer/swarm/20261011/representative-2110/source/execution_supervisor_group_linux.go.txt), [final cancel-ready raw receipt](https://github.com/joshyorko/rcc/blob/6a1ddce272211fbdc84a9100bf45f55c32710810/developer/swarm/20261011/representative-2110/results-group-2/cancel-control-worker.jsonl), [before-fallback identity readback](https://github.com/joshyorko/rcc/blob/6a1ddce272211fbdc84a9100bf45f55c32710810/developer/swarm/20261011/representative-2110/results-group-2/readiness-fallback.json). Earlier failed private-home0750 is unrepaired. Escape/session changes, hostile/concurrent tasks, long-lived reuse, native macOS/Windows and production acceptance are unqualified; this prototype does not clear132.
